event.title: 2016 PIAA AAA 120 LBS Wrestling State Finals
event.description: Spencer Lee techfalls Austin Desanto in 3 minutes 43 seconds. Claiming his 3rd state title in the process.

event.title: 2017 PIAA AAA 126 LBS Wrestling State Finals
event.description: Austin Desanto beats Spencer Lee in the state finals with a score of 6-5. Desanto handed Lee his first and only loss in his entire PIAA highschool career.

event.title: Spencer Lee sign commits to The University of Iowa
event.description: Spencer Lee signs national letter of intent in Franklin Regional Senior Highschool and announces he will continue his wrestling career as a Hawkeye at The University of Iowa.

event.title: Austin Desanto commits to Drexel University
event.description: Austin Desanto signs national letter of intent in Exeter Township Highschool and announces he will continue his wrestling career as a dragon at Drexel University.

event.title: Desanto flips commitment to Iowa
event.description: Austin Desanto announced his transfer to join former opponent, Spencer Lee, and the Iowa Hawkeyes.
